label: Long turn with multiple opportunities
parts: Let me walk through the design in more detail. First the client uploads a document and receives a tracking number. The service stores the file and puts a message on a queue. A worker picks up the message and extracts the text. If processing fails, it retries with a delay. We keep track of every attempt so that support can explain what happened. Once processing completes, the worker updates the database and sends a notification. We also measure the time spent at each step and alert the team when the queue gets too large. Finally we clean up old temporary files after checking that the results were saved successfully.
